profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Kopacetic Inc. | MSECE (Machine Learning and Data Science) @ USC
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience in building AI and data based solutions. I have graduated from University of Southern California with my Master's in Electrical and Computer Engineering with a specialization in Machine Learning and Data Science.

Recently, that’s looked like building a multimodal LLM service for meeting intelligence-ingesting voice + facial signals, auto-annotating behavior, and shipping it on Cloud Run with monitoring that actually catches drift before customers do. I also led a small team to ship an agenda-checker pipeline (LLMs + rules), complete with a Node.js API and a React dashboard, so teams can track what got done-without another spreadsheet.

Before that, I worked as a data scientist automating weekly reporting (96% faster than the manual process), building a reliable ETL to migrate thousands of products into Odoo, and training forecasting models on SageMaker that beat our baselines on both WAPE and bias. I like the full stack of ML: from data plumbing and validation to modeling and the dashboards people actually use.

On the side, I’ve shipped hands-on projects: an agentic supply-chain planner (FastAPI + LangGraph + OR-Tools on AWS) that optimizes routes and reduces stockouts; a RAG-based mental health chatbot (FastAPI + LangChain) tuned for fast, grounded responses; and a real-time intrusion-detection pipeline with proper CI/CD.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Built a multimodal LLM service for a meeting-intelligence platform that ingests vocal and facial data and auto-annotates, scores behaviors from 0 to 100, streams results to BigQuery and is deployed on GCP Cloud Run, improving annotation accuracy by 35%
• Led a team of 3 to build an Agenda-Checker Natural Language Processing (NLP) pipeline using LLMs plus rule-based checks to extract agenda items and completion signals, and delivered a Node.js REST API and a React dashboard for agenda tracking
• Designed GKE Autopilot to cut cold-start tails and enable fine-grained autoscaling with Terraform + Helm, Workload Identity, NetworkPolicies, and HPA, and a staging cluster via Argo CD
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · MongoDB · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Docker · React.js

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
• Automated weekly sales and inventory reporting for ops leadership by replacing manual spreadsheets with a Python plus MySQL program and a scheduled validation, cutting report generation time by 96%
• Built an Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) pipeline to migrate 2,000+ products into Odoo with field mapping, deduplication, and pre and post-load checks for reliability, plus batched, incremental loads and indexed queries for scalability
• Developed an inventory-forecasting Machine Learning (ML) module on AWS SageMaker using XGBoost with a custom ARIMA baseline, achieving 12% lower WAPE and 3% bias than baseline on 2 to 4 week horizons across top SKUs

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
- Compared machine learning (ML) techniques like K-Means and K-modes clustering  to classify over 10,000 customers into behavioral segments, enabling targeted promotional strategies that reduced churn rate by 5%
- Developed a Python-based module to analyze top-selling products and forecast inventory, integrated with the Odoo Web Library and deployed on Bitbucket, reducing task runtime by 40%

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
• Implemented a Python based recommendation system for overseas-study users that ranks candidates from profile and preference
• Extracted free-text intents with TF-IDF and word embeddings, capturing 90%+ of categories and improving match relevance
• Modeled a match score with regression and a PyTorch neural network, achieving 91% testing accuracy on held-out data

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Engineered a FastAPI REST backend in Python for online workspace platform using SQLAlchemy and PostgreSQL while implementing JWT auth, RBAC, and input validation, achieving 350 RPS (requests per second) and zero downtime
• Shipped a React and TypeScript dashboard with WebSockets for real-time workflow updates for 300 concurrent users

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
• Created machine learning models using Linear and Logistic Regression algorithms to predict the score based on the
number of hours a student can study.
• Hands on experience with data visualization techniques using Python and Tableau.

positions.title: Web Software Developer
positions.description:
▪ Worked primarily on the website of Brisionel Agrotech which was a start-up on dry fruits selling.
▪ Worked on Wix and WordPress along with web dev tools which enabled the changes using HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
▪ Led a group of 4 people making a blog page of Trudawn which highlights what services the company offers to clients.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Electrical and Computer Engineering - Machine Learning and Data Science

projects.title: Smart Supply Chain Planner – Agentic Logistics System
projects.description:
• Built a multi-agent AI system using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to automate demand forecasting, routing, and procurement decisions in a simulated logistics network spanning 80+ orders and 2 distribution centers
• Implemented autonomous agents for Demand, Inventory, Procurement with FastAPI, LangGraph, and Python OR-Tools, deployed via AWS ECS, Lambda, and RDS with S3 for data storage and a Next.js dashboard for human-in-the-loop approvals
• Delivered a scalable orchestration platform that reduced total route distance by 40%, cut stockouts by 30%, and lowered simulated logistics costs by 20%, while enabling real-time replanning through agentic coordination

projects.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Based Mental Health Chatbot
projects.description:
• Built a supportive mental-health chatbot with a FastAPI and Uvicorn service integrating LangChain and OpenAI to deliver fast,
grounded answers, reducing median response time to 1.1s
• Optimized a RAG pipeline on Azure PostgreSQL with OpenAI embeddings, deployed via Docker on Azure App Service,
achieving 98.33% unique document retrieval

skills.name: LangChain, HuggingFace, Python, Transformers, BLEU, PEFT, PyTorch, NLP techniques, Git.
